aiAudit.reason: The diff replaces a per-test `TcpNioConnectionSupport` mock with a field re-initialized to a fresh mock in @BeforeEach, which is the intended promotion pattern. No stubbing, argument matcher or answer exists on this mock, and the only assertions are identity checks (`isSameAs`) against the same instance passed to `connectionSupport(...)` in each test, so no test can now pass for a different reason. Because @BeforeEach creates a new instance per test case, there is no cross-test sharing of accumulated interactions or mutable state and no execution-order dependency. Both call sites were actually replaced, so the duplication was genuinely removed.

aiAudit.reason: The extraction only hoists fresh-per-test mock creation into a @BeforeEach field: 'this.mockedSession = Mockito.mock(Session.class);' runs before every test method, so no mock instance is shared across test cases. The stubbing is preserved verbatim in behavior and arguments, changing only the returned instance from the local variable to the field ('thenReturn(session)' -> 'thenReturn(mockedSession)'). Neither test asserts on accumulated interactions or mutable state of the Session mock itself; the only verification, 'Mockito.verify(sessionFactory, Mockito.times(2)).getSession();', targets sessionFactory, which is still created locally in the test body. Both call sites were actually replaced, so the duplication was genuinely removed.
